exposure: previous preterm cesarean delivery between 22 and 28 weeks gestation
outcome: pregnancy outcomes (gestational age at delivery, mode of delivery)
cohort: 103 women with a history of cesarean delivery between 22 and 28 weeks gestation from December 1, 2014 to December 31, 2017.
finding: Women with previous preterm cesarean delivery between 22-28 weeks had a high subsequent pregnancy rate (45.6%) with the majority achieving term gestation, though most subsequent deliveries were also cesarean.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the most common mode of delivery in subsequent pregnancies (79.3%).
